prompt:
The section file sections/featured-product-wrapper.liquid shows one featured product. It has optional wrapper elements. Its markup is correct and must stay exactly as it is. Only the JSON inside the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block must be fixed.

The markup reads these settings under section.settings:
- product: a product object, may be null.
- full_width: boolean. When false, the content is wrapped in a div with class page-width.
- heading: text, may be an empty string. When it is blank, the header wrapper element is omitted.
- show_vendor: boolean. Controls the optional vendor paragraph.

The schema must be exactly this, with keys and array items in this order:
- "name": "Featured product"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section"
- "settings", an array with four entries:
  1. type "product", id "product", label "Product". No default.
  2. type "checkbox", id "full_width", label "Make section full width", default false. This must be the JSON boolean false, not a string.
  3. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Featured product".
  4. type "checkbox", id "show_vendor", label "Show vendor", default true. This must be the JSON boolean true, not a string.
- "presets": [{"name": "Featured product"}]

The schema must have no other keys, settings or blocks. Change only sections/featured-product-wrapper.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
